Name: F1F4's Anniversary Gift
Author: F1F4
Description:
[i][b]// UPDATE 1.0!
[/b]> [/i]Moving forward.

Hey everybody! This mod has grown to be something for a little! Nonetheless, I hate to be the bearer of bad news. Unfortunately, this ex-partner of mine has engaged in hideous behaviors, including neglect, disloyalty, gaslighting, and other categories that fit under this line. Whilst I've been patient with it, more a fool, I decided to finally let go and construct a new romantic foundation around me. Considering this mod's success, I will not be deleting it to avoid erasing myself and Jojo's efforts, so instead, this mod will be revamped into an original character rather than an anniversary gift shortly. Thank you all!



[img]https://i.imgur.com/uxwdtZq.png[/img]
> [b]1.0.0﻿[/b]﻿
Heya! I am the author, and I am typically referred to as [b]'F1F4'[/b]--I know, plain and simple given it's my gaming username. This is my [b]first time[/b] creating a mod for this relaxing game. The inspiration for this mod being created stemmed from my love for my partner; we binged-played Stardew Valley, and it struck me one day that I should make a mod for my partner. This is the final product, and I wholeheartedly hope my partner enjoys this [i][u]anniversary present.

[/u][/i][img]https://i.imgur.com/aS4AEuu.png[/img]
> [b]Details!﻿
[/b]- This Custom NPC Mod is meant to embody a virtual mimic of my partner, only though... this one seems to be conscious of its livelihood in a mere video game. This mod features a complete set of (2,4,6,8,10) heart events and total involvement in all festivals, including Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village. Dialogue for each day, with the exclusive dialogue of 'Happy Anniversary' on each 25th of a season. That is, considering, the release of this mod. It's for the anniversary!! 
- A unique outfit made for the festival dance, by yours truly. 
- A wedding dress made for the wedding ceremony, by yours truly. (hehe)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9yITLYd.png[/img]
> [b]Credits﻿
[/b]- I had done all the coding for this mod, and the optimization of each script and its counterpart, as the same with the default walking sprites of this character and all basic entities.
~ However, I must thank all the mod authors that I have met and got to know by giving me advice and a little guidance.
 - Most importantly, a huge credit to the user ([b]jojowakagiogiowds[/b]) on Discord for helping me TONS with the beautiful sprite art animations. They are, by all means, talented and do deserve the credit.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/26OObRF.png[/img]
> [b]Support![/b]
- Given that this mod is really.. only applicable to my partner considering it is a gift. You can also always support me in many different ways, whether it is including this NPC to engage in your world and playthroughs or generally just checkin' out and praising the mod! Who wouldn't want a drawer, singer personality to shine in your world? 
- Additionally! Another way of supporting me is by commissioning my partner's art! You can do this by messaging me on discord--A kofi for them will be made soon, that way you guys can support their art and show a really talented artist some love.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/B1rtTVC.png[/img]
> [b]Schedule!﻿
[/b]It is extremely difficult to list out the full schedule considering it is a large file, but do not hesitate to explore the place or the modfile for the schedule! Do bare in mind that this NPC will the majority of the time be in Ridgeside Village, and will spawn in the Log Hotel Cabin 2nd floor. The NPC will also be hangin' about in the Town a lot in Winter Season. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eixEDGe.png[/img]
> [b]Tastes!﻿
[/b]Hmmm.. think savory, sweet food and Mexican food..
~ Jokes aside, this also has a large list considering my partner loves a lot of things; how about you play around with the NPC and find out? I shoulda' already gave a hint!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kSgRj3l.png[/img]
